name: Vostok-4
about: Vostok-4 (1962 A NU 1), a crewed vehicle (Vostok3A), launched 1962 Aug 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1962 Aug 12), held fixed
